answers.evidence:
Verified with 10 tests covering the full pipeline and all edge cases:

```
=== RUN   TestPipeline_SubmitAndQueue          --- PASS
=== RUN   TestPipeline_SolveFromQueue          --- PASS
=== RUN   TestPipeline_SolveEmptyQueue         --- PASS (edge case: empty queue error)
=== RUN   TestPipeline_VerifySolvedTicket      --- PASS
=== RUN   TestPipeline_VerifyUnsolvedTicket    --- PASS (edge case: verify before solve)
=== RUN   TestPipeline_VerifyEmptySolution     --- PASS (edge case: empty solution)
=== RUN   TestPipeline_DiscoverAfterSolve      --- PASS
=== RUN   TestPipeline_DiscoverAfterVerify     --- PASS
=== RUN   TestPipeline_FullPipelineE2E         --- PASS (full e2e walkthrough)
=== RUN   TestPipeline_ConcurrentAccess        --- PASS (10 goroutines, race-free)
```

Additional verification:
- `go vet` — clean
- `go build -race` — no race conditions detected
- Binary execution demonstrates the full pipeline output end-to-end

**Edge cases tested:**
1. Solving from an empty queue returns an error
2. Verifying an unsolved ticket is rejected
3. Verifying a ticket with empty/corrupt solution is rejected
4. Concurrent submissions from 10 goroutines are handled safely
5. Discover returns empty results when no tickets have been solved yet
6. Discover correctly reports both "solved" and "verified" insights after state transitions
